adaptation_notes: preprocessing.py is a line-for-line port of load_feature_table / define_condition_relative_stages / get_raw_numeric_sensor_cols / build_online_features_for_subset / build_online_features_by_split / feature_cols_from / fill_by_train_median / select_features_train_only / fit_train_gmm / assign_fine_states / build_windows from main_experiment_3_fgds_psi_optimized.py, and split_by_conditions from common_pipeline.py (itself a verbatim port of 代码/7.7跨工况实验.py::split_train_val_by_conditions).

ONLY task/seed/output routing changed, no algorithm change: train_conditions/test_condition/preprocess_seed are now explicit function parameters instead of hardcoded module constants (RANDOM_SEED=42, C1+C4->C6); diagnostic side-file writes (selected_features.csv, threshold summaries, gmm_fine_state_mapping.csv) were removed from these pure data-transform functions -- the adapter/orchestrator decides what to persist per RESULTS_POLICY.md instead.

FEATURE_FILE now defaults to this repo's own data/PHM2010/features/run_level_features_all.csv (sha256-verified identical copy) instead of the old project's baselines/htt_net/data/ path, overridable via PHM2010_FEATURES env var.
RF model itself (RandomForestClassifier, n_estimators=400, class_weight=balanced_subsample) is unchanged from final_statistical_evidence/scripts/methods/run_internal_methods_transfer_task.py::run_rf.

Test evaluation restricted to run_ids present in the L=12 window-feasible set (meta_test['cut_index']), matching the historical run_rf() behavior exactly, so RF's test universe matches the other window-based methods' common evaluation universe (run_id 12-315, n=304).
